beak.definition:
n. beaklike mouth of animals other than birds (e.g., turtles)
n. horny projecting mouth of a bird
n. a beaklike, tapering tip on certain plant structures
n. informal terms for the nose
beak.translation:
n. 鸟嘴, 喙
[医] 嘴, 喙

beaked.definition: a. having or resembling a beak
beaked.translation: a. 有喙的, 鸟嘴状的

beaker.definition:
n. a flatbottomed jar made of glass or plastic; used for chemistry
n. a cup (usually without a handle)
beaker.translation:
n. 大口酒杯, 烧杯
[化] 烧杯

beakers.definition:
n. a flatbottomed jar made of glass or plastic; used for chemistry
n. a cup (usually without a handle)
beakers.translation: n. 高脚杯( beaker的复数形式 ); 烧杯

beakful.translation: n. (鸟的)一满喙之量，一嘴之量

beakhead.definition:
n. An ornament used in rich Norman doorways, resembling a
   head with a beak.
n. A small platform at the fore part of the upper deck of a
   vessel, which contains the water closets of the crew.
n. Same as Beak, 3.
beakhead.translation: (舰船的)撞角, (船首楼前的)沟形厕所

beakie.translation: [美俚]暗中监视工会会员的警察

beaking.definition:
-ing form of beak
n. beaklike mouth of animals other than birds (e.g., turtles)
n. horny projecting mouth of a bird
n. a beaklike, tapering tip on certain plant structures
n. informal terms for the nose
beaking.translation:
(beak 的现在分词) n. 鸟嘴, 喙

beakiron.definition:
n. A bickern; a bench anvil with a long beak, adapted to
   reach the interior surface of sheet metal ware; the horn of an anvil.

beakless.definition: a not having a beak or bill

beaklike.definition: s resembling the beak of a bird
